This field captures the IP address of the authentication request for security monitoring and session management. Stored in hrm_platform_member_sessions. The field is optional to support server-side rendering (SSR) scenarios where the client may not know its own IP and the server provides it as a fallback. When provided, must be a valid IPv4 address format.
ip.x-autobe-specification: Session context field captured from request. Stored in hrm_platform_member_sessions.ip for security audit. Not mapped to hrm_platform_members table. Optional to support SSR scenarios where server captures IP as fallback. Format: IPv4 address.

IHrmPlatformMember.ILogin.description:
Login credentials for member authentication with email and password.

Used to authenticate a member by validating their email and password against the hrm_platform_members table. The password is provided in plain text and will be hashed by the backend for comparison with the stored password_hash.

Session context fields (href, referrer, ip) are captured for security audit and recorded in hrm_platform_member_sessions. The ip field is optional to support server-side rendering (SSR) scenarios where the client IP may not be available.
IHrmPlatformMember.ILogin.x-autobe-specification: Login request DTO for member authentication. Maps email to hrm_platform_members.email for lookup, password (plain text) to password_hash for bcrypt/argon2 verification. Session context fields (href, referrer, ip) are captured from request headers/body and stored in hrm_platform_member_sessions for security audit, not from hrm_platform_members table. Backend hashes the provided password before comparing with stored password_hash.

search.description: General text search across department name and description fields.

name.description: Filter departments by partial match on name.

description.description: Filter departments by partial match on description.

parentDepartmentId.description: Filter departments by parent department ID for hierarchical queries.

IHrmPlatformDepartment.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for listing departments with search, filtering, and pagination support.

This type defines the filter criteria and pagination parameters for retrieving a paginated list of departments within an organization. All properties are optional, allowing callers to retrieve all departments without filters or apply specific search criteria.

The {@link search} property performs a general text search across both name and description fields. For more targeted filtering, use {@link name} or {@link description} properties individually. The {@link parentDepartmentId} property filters departments by their parent department, enabling retrieval of child departments within a specific hierarchy level.

Pagination is controlled through {@link page} and {@link limit} properties. Sorting can be customized using {@link sort} and {@link order} properties.
IHrmPlatformDepartment.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query parameters for filtering hrm_platform_departments table. search: partial match on name OR description fields. name: partial match on name field only. description: partial match on description field only. parentDepartmentId: exact match on parent_department_id field (UUID). page: pagination page number (1-based, default 1). limit: items per page (1-100, default 20). sort: field to sort by (name, created_at). order: sort direction (asc, desc). All filters are combined with AND logic.

refresh_token.description:
The current refresh token to validate and exchange for new tokens.

This JWT token was issued during the initial guest join operation or a previous refresh. The server validates this token against the hrm_platform_guest_sessions table to verify the session is still active and has not expired.

The token must be a valid JWT string. If the token is invalid, malformed, expired, or the associated guest account has been deleted, the refresh operation will fail with a 401 Unauthorized error and the client must create a new guest session via the join endpoint.
refresh_token.x-autobe-specification: JWT refresh token string provided by client. Validated against hrm_platform_guest_sessions table: verify token signature, check expired_at > current time, confirm referenced guest account exists and is not soft-deleted. Server-side computation generates new token pair upon successful validation.

IHrmPlatformGuest.IRefresh.description:
Guest session refresh request containing the current refresh token.

This request is submitted to POST /hrmPlatform/auth/guest/refresh to renew an expiring guest session. The client provides the current refresh token, which the server validates against the hrm_platform_guest_sessions table.

The refresh_token field contains the JWT refresh token string. Upon successful validation, the server generates a new access token and refresh token pair with updated expiration timestamps.
IHrmPlatformGuest.IRefresh.x-autobe-specification: Request body for guest session refresh endpoint. Contains only refresh_token field. The token is validated against hrm_platform_guest_sessions table by checking: (1) token signature and claims, (2) session expiration (expired_at > current time), (3) referenced guest account exists and is not deleted. Upon successful validation, server generates new access/refresh token pair with updated timestamps. No direct database table mapping - this is a session authentication request DTO.

hrm_platform_organization_id.description:
Filter memberships by organization ID.

When provided, returns only memberships associated with the specified organization. Must be a valid UUID format. Optional parameter for targeted queries.
hrm_platform_organization_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.hrm_platform_organization_id. Filters by exact UUID match.

hrm_platform_member_id.description:
Filter memberships by member ID.

When provided, returns only memberships for the specified member across all organizations. Must be a valid UUID format. Useful for finding all organizations a user belongs to.
hrm_platform_member_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.hrm_platform_member_id. Filters by exact UUID match.

is_owner.description:
Filter memberships by ownership status.

When true, returns only memberships where the member is the organization owner. When false, returns only non-owner memberships. Optional parameter for role-based filtering.
is_owner.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.is_owner. Filters by boolean match.

search.description:
Full-text search across member emails and organization names.

Performs case-insensitive partial matching on member email addresses and organization display names. Useful for finding memberships when you know the user's email or organization name but not their IDs.
search.x-autobe-specification: Text search across joined member.email and organization.name fields. Server performs LIKE query on both fields and returns matches.

limit.description:
Maximum number of records to return per page.

Controls pagination batch size. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20 if not provided. Higher values reduce API calls but increase response size.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Pagination limit parameter. Defaults to 20, maximum 100. Controls maximum records per page.

sort.description:
Sort order for results.

Format is field:direction where direction is asc or desc. Defaults to created_at:desc (newest memberships first). Allows custom ordering based on any indexed field.
sort.x-autobe-specification: Sort parameter in field:direction format. Defaults to created_at:desc. Supported fields: created_at, is_owner, or related entity fields via JOIN.

page.description:
Target page number to retrieve (1-indexed).

Specifies which page of results to return. Page numbering starts from 1. If omitted, null, or undefined, defaults to page 1 (first page). Requesting a page beyond the available range returns an empty data array with valid pagination metadata reflecting the actual totals.
page.x-autobe-specification: 1-indexed page number. Defaults to 1 if null or omitted. Server validates and bounds-checks against total pages.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationMembership.IRequ.description:
Request parameters for querying organization memberships with filtering and pagination support.

This type defines the search criteria and pagination controls for retrieving organization membership records. All fields are optional, allowing flexible queries from simple listings to specific filtered results.

Use hrm_platform_organization_id to filter memberships by a specific organization. Use hrm_platform_member_id to find all organizations a specific member belongs to. Use is_owner to filter by ownership status.

The search field performs text matching on member email addresses and organization names. Pagination is controlled via limit and sort parameters.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationMembership.IRequ.x-autobe-specification: Query parameters for filtering and paginating hrm_platform_organization_memberships. Filters: hrm_platform_organization_id (exact UUID match), hrm_platform_member_id (exact UUID match), is_owner (boolean match). Search: text search on member email or organization name via JOIN. Pagination: limit (default 20, max 100), sort (field:direction format, default created_at:desc), page (1-indexed, defaults to 1). Server excludes deleted_at IS NOT NULL records automatically.

refresh_token.description:
Long-lived refresh token for obtaining new access tokens without re-authentication.

This token is issued during member registration, login, or prior token refresh operations. It is used to request new access tokens when the current access token expires, allowing session continuation without requiring the user to re-enter credentials.

The token is validated against the hrm_platform_member_sessions table. It must match an active session where expired_at is in the future and the associated member account has not been deleted (deleted_at is null). Typical lifetime ranges from 7 to 30 days depending on security configuration. The token may be rotated on each refresh for enhanced security.
refresh_token.x-autobe-specification: Refresh token string validated against hrm_platform_member_sessions.refresh_token column. Server queries session table by this value, validates expired_at > now and associated member deleted_at is null. Token must match an active, non-expired session. On validation success, server issues new access_token and optionally rotates refresh_token. Session updated_at is refreshed. Returns 401 if token invalid, expired, or member deactivated.

IHrmPlatformMember.IRefresh.description:
Request payload for refreshing authentication tokens without re-authentication.

Contains the refresh_token obtained from a previous authentication response (member join, login, or prior refresh). The token is validated against active sessions in the hrm_platform_member_sessions table. The session must not be expired (expired_at must be in the future) and the associated member account must be active (deleted_at is null).

Upon successful validation, the server returns new access and refresh tokens in the IHrmPlatformMember.IAuthorized response. The old refresh token may be invalidated as part of token rotation for enhanced security following OAuth 2.0 best practices. This enables seamless session continuation without requiring users to re-enter credentials.
IHrmPlatformMember.IRefresh.x-autobe-specification: Request body for member token refresh endpoint POST /hrmPlatform/auth/member/refresh. Contains refresh_token string that is validated against hrm_platform_member_sessions.refresh_token column. Server queries the session table by refresh_token value, validates expired_at > current timestamp and associated member account deleted_at is null. On successful validation, generates new JWT access_token and optionally rotates refresh_token per OAuth 2.0 best practices. Session updated_at timestamp is refreshed on each successful token refresh. Returns 401 Unauthorized if refresh_token is invalid, expired, or member account is deactivated.

organization_id.description:
Reference to the organization that will own this role.

The organization ID identifies which organization this custom role belongs to. All roles are scoped to a single organization and cannot be shared across organizations. The value must be a valid UUID referencing an existing organization record.

This field is required when creating a custom role. The user must have appropriate permissions within the specified organization to create roles.
organization_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.organization_id. Must reference existing organization. Foreign key constraint enforced.

name.description:
Role name displayed in the UI and used for identification.

The name identifies the role within the organization and must be unique among all roles (both built-in and custom) in that organization. Examples include 'HR Manager', 'Finance Lead', or 'Team Coordinator'.

This field is required when creating a custom role. The name cannot duplicate existing role names within the same organization, including the built-in roles 'Owner', 'Manager', and 'Employee'.
name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.name. Must be unique within the organization per @@unique([organization_id, name]) constraint.

description.description:
Optional description explaining the role's purpose and typical use cases.

The description provides context about what responsibilities and access levels this custom role represents. It is primarily used for documentation purposes to help administrators understand when to assign this role to employees.

This field is optional and can be null. Built-in roles may have null descriptions as their purposes are well-defined, while custom roles often benefit from clear descriptions.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.description. Nullable field - can be null or string. Optional for custom roles.

permission_ids.description:
Array of permission IDs to assign to this role.

Each permission ID in this array references a record in the permissions table and grants that specific capability to roles assigned this permission set. The system creates entries in the role_permissions junction table for each ID provided.

This field is optional - a role can be created without permissions and updated later. However, a role with no permissions grants no access to its assigned employees. Available permissions include org:manage, employee:manage, employee:view, project:manage, project:view, time:manage, time:approve, time:view_all, and report:view.
permission_ids.x-autobe-specification: Computed property - not a direct DB column. Each permission_id in the array creates one record in hrm_platform_role_permissions junction table linking the new role to the specified permission. Validation: each ID must reference existing hrm_platform_permissions record.

IHrmPlatformRole.ICreate.description:
Request payload for creating a new custom role within an organization.

This DTO is used when organization owners or users with appropriate permissions create custom roles with specific permission combinations. The role is scoped to the specified organization and automatically marked as a custom role (not built-in).

The role name must be unique within the target organization. Permissions are assigned by providing an array of permission IDs, which creates entries in the role_permissions junction table.
IHrmPlatformRole.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_roles table for direct fields (organization_id, name, description). Permission assignments handled separately via hrm_platform_role_permissions junction table - each permission_id creates one junction record. Excluded: id (auto-generated UUID), is_built_in (auto-set to false for custom roles), timestamps (auto-managed), organization relation (replaced by FK), reverse relations (not user-provided). Validation: organization_id must reference existing organization, name must be unique within organization per @@unique([organization_id, name]) constraint.

code.description:
Partial match filter for permission code.

Filters permissions by searching for the provided string pattern within permission codes using case-insensitive partial matching. For example, searching 'employee' returns permissions like 'employee:manage', 'employee:view', and 'employee:invite'.

Use this field to quickly locate permissions within a specific domain area without knowing the exact permission code.
code.x-autobe-specification: Partial match filter using SQL LIKE on hrm_platform_permissions.code. Case-insensitive search for permission code patterns (e.g., 'employee' matches 'employee:manage', 'employee:view').

description.description:
Full-text search keywords for permission description.

Searches the human-readable description field of permissions for matching keywords. This allows finding permissions by their functional purpose rather than code name.

For example, searching 'timesheet' returns permissions with descriptions mentioning timesheet approval or viewing. Multiple keywords can be provided for broader matching.
description.x-autobe-specification: Full-text search on hrm_platform_permissions.description field. Searches for keywords within the human-readable permission description text.

deleted.description:
Filter by soft-delete status.

Controls whether soft-deleted permission records are included in results. When set to true, only soft-deleted records are returned. When set to false, only active records are returned. When omitted or null, the default behavior returns only active records.

Soft-deleted permissions are typically system-managed reference data that may be marked inactive but preserved for historical integrity. Most use cases should omit this field to work with active permissions only.
deleted.x-autobe-specification: Computed boolean filter parameter. Translates to SQL condition on hrm_platform_permissions.deleted_at: true → WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL (deleted only), false → WHERE deleted_at IS NULL (active only), null/omitted → WHERE deleted_at IS NULL (active by default). No direct DB column - this is a query logic parameter.

page.description:
Page number for pagination, starting from 1.

Specifies which page of results to retrieve. Page numbering is 1-indexed, meaning the first page is page 1 (not 0). This value is used to calculate the database query offset.

For example, with limit=20, page=1 returns records 1-20, page=2 returns records 21-40, and so on. Must be a positive integer with minimum value of 1.
page.x-autobe-specification: Query control parameter for cursor-based pagination. No DB mapping - used to calculate OFFSET: (page - 1) * limit. Must be integer >= 1. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description:
Number of items per page, maximum 100.

Controls how many permission records are returned in a single response page. This value is used as the LIMIT clause in the database query.

The minimum value is 1 and the maximum is 100 records per page. Larger limits reduce the number of API calls needed but increase response size. Choose based on your UI requirements and performance considerations.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Query control parameter for page size. No DB mapping - used as LIMIT clause value. Must be integer between 1 and 100 inclusive. Defaults to system default if omitted.

sort.description:
Sort field with optional direction.

Specifies which field to sort results by and in what order. The format is the field name optionally followed by a space and direction (ASC for ascending, DESC for descending).

Default sort order is 'code ASC' when this field is omitted. Valid sort fields include code, description, created_at, and deleted_at. For example, 'created_at DESC' returns newest permissions first, while 'code' or 'code ASC' returns permissions alphabetically by code.
sort.x-autobe-specification: Query control parameter for ORDER BY clause. No DB mapping - specifies sort field name with optional direction (ASC/DESC). Default is 'code ASC' when omitted. Valid fields: code, description, created_at, deleted_at.

IHrmPlatformPermission.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for querying the permission catalog with filtering and pagination support.

This type defines the search criteria and pagination controls for retrieving permission definitions from the hrm_platform_permissions table. Use it to filter permissions by code pattern or description keywords, include or exclude soft-deleted records, and navigate through paginated results.

The code field performs partial matching on permission codes using SQL LIKE (e.g., 'employee' matches 'employee:manage' and 'employee:view'). The description field supports full-text search on permission descriptions. The deleted flag filters by soft-delete status - when true, only soft-deleted records are returned; when false, only active records; when omitted or null, active records are returned by default.

Pagination is controlled by page and limit parameters, with a maximum of 100 items per page. Results are sorted by code ascending by default, but you can customize sorting using the sort field with optional direction (e.g., 'code DESC').
IHrmPlatformPermission.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query parameters for filtering hrm_platform_permissions table. Maps to search fields: code (partial match LIKE on permission code), description (full-text search on description), deleted (boolean filter translating to deleted_at nullability check). Pagination via page/limit, sorting via sort field. No direct DB mapping for page, limit, sort - these are query control parameters. The deleted_at column is filtered indirectly via the deleted boolean parameter.

email.description:
Unique email address used for authentication and communication.

This email serves as the primary identifier for login and password recovery processes. Must be unique across all member accounts in the system. The email address is used to send verification tokens, password reset links, and system notifications.

Format must follow standard email conventions (RFC 5322). Maximum length is 255 characters. The system performs case-insensitive uniqueness checks to prevent duplicate accounts with different casing.
email.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.email. Must be unique across all members (enforced by DB unique index). Validated for email format.

password.description:
Plain text password for account authentication.

This password is used to authenticate the member during login. The plain text value is never stored; it is hashed using bcrypt or argon2 before being persisted to the database.

Password must meet security requirements: minimum 8 characters in length, at least one uppercase letter (A-Z), at least one lowercase letter (a-z), and at least one numeric digit (0-9). Stronger passwords are encouraged but not enforced beyond these minimum requirements.
password.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_members.password_hash. Backend hashes the plain text password using bcrypt or argon2 before storage. Never store plain text passwords. Validation: minimum 8 characters, at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.

href.description:
Current page URL where registration was initiated.

This field records the exact URL of the registration page when the user submitted their registration form. Used for audit trails, analytics, and understanding user acquisition funnels.

The value is stored in the session record (hrm_platform_member_sessions) rather than the member record, as it pertains to the specific registration session rather than the member account itself. Format must be a valid URI.
href.x-autobe-specification: Session context field stored in hrm_platform_member_sessions table, not in hrm_platform_members. Captures the URL where registration was initiated for audit and analytics purposes.

referrer.description:
Referrer URL that led to the registration page.

This field records the URL of the page the user visited immediately before arriving at the registration page. Used for attribution tracking, marketing analytics, and understanding user navigation patterns.

The value is stored in the session record (hrm_platform_member_sessions) rather than the member record, as it pertains to the specific registration session. Format must be a valid URI. May be empty if the user navigated directly or if referrer information is not available.
referrer.x-autobe-specification: Session context field stored in hrm_platform_member_sessions table, not in hrm_platform_members. Captures the referrer URL that led the user to the registration page for attribution tracking.

ip.description:
Client IP address at time of registration.

This field records the IP address from which the registration request was made. Used for security auditing, fraud detection, and geographic analytics.

The value is stored in the session record (hrm_platform_member_sessions) rather than the member record, as it pertains to the specific registration session. This field is optional to support server-side rendering scenarios where the client cannot determine its own IP address - in such cases, the server captures the IP as a fallback. Format must be a valid IPv4 address when provided.
ip.x-autobe-specification: Session context field stored in hrm_platform_member_sessions table, not in hrm_platform_members. Optional because in server-side rendering (SSR) the client cannot know its own IP - the server captures it as fallback (body.ip ?? serverIp). Format: IPv4 address.

IHrmPlatformMember.IJoin.description:
Registration credentials for creating a new member account.

Contains the email address and password required to create a new authenticated user account. Email must be unique across all members and follows standard email format. Password must meet security requirements: minimum 8 characters, at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.

The href and referrer fields capture the registration context for audit and analytics purposes. The ip field records the client's IP address when available, but is optional to support server-side rendering scenarios where the client cannot determine its own IP.

Upon successful registration, an email verification token is generated and sent asynchronously to the provided email address. JWT access and refresh tokens are returned in the response for immediate authentication. New members have no organization membership initially and must create or join an organization to access organization-scoped features.
IHrmPlatformMember.IJoin.x-autobe-specification: Maps email to hrm_platform_members.email directly. Maps password to hrm_platform_members.password_hash via bcrypt/argon2 hashing. Session context fields (href, referrer, ip) are stored in hrm_platform_member_sessions table, not in members table. Excluded: id (auto-generated UUID), created_at/updated_at (auto timestamps), deleted_at (soft delete managed by system), and all relations (sessions, passwordResets, emailVerifications, organizationMemberships, profile, employees, sentInvitations, taskHistories, reviewedTimesheets, activityLogs) as they are not part of registration request.

id.description:
The unique identifier of the guest account.

This UUID is automatically generated when the guest account is created. It identifies the guest throughout their session and is used to track their activity on the platform.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_guests.id. UUID format.

token.x-autobe-specification: Authorization token comes from the session table.

IHrmPlatformGuest.IAuthorized.description:
Guest authentication response containing the guest identifier and JWT session tokens.

This type is returned when a guest account is created via the join operation or when refreshing an existing guest session. The response includes the guest's unique identifier and a token object containing the access token, refresh token, and expiration timestamps.

The access token is used for authenticating subsequent API requests. The refresh token is used to obtain new access tokens when the current one expires via the refresh operation. The expired_at timestamp indicates when the access token expires, and refreshable_until indicates the absolute session expiration deadline.
IHrmPlatformGuest.IAuthorized.x-autobe-specification: Response DTO for guest authentication. Direct: id from hrm_platform_guests.id. Computed: token object from hrm_platform_guest_sessions with access (JWT), refresh (JWT), expired_at (ISO datetime), refreshable_until (ISO datetime). Tokens generated by auth middleware based on session configuration.

device_fingerprint.description:
Optional unique identifier derived from device characteristics for guest tracking.

The device fingerprint uniquely identifies the visitor's device and persists across browser sessions. When provided, it must be unique across all guest accounts. If omitted, the server automatically generates a fingerprint from request characteristics.

This enables the platform to maintain guest state across page loads and browser sessions without requiring authentication, and supports features like preserving registration form state across page reloads.
device_fingerprint.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to hrm_platform_guests.device_fingerprint. Optional field - if not provided in request, server generates unique fingerprint from request characteristics. Must be unique across all guest records.

href.description:
The URL the guest was accessing when registration was initiated.

This field captures the entry point URL for session context tracking. It is stored in the hrm_platform_guest_sessions table (not in hrm_platform_guests) to maintain audit trail of how the guest arrived at the platform.

Required for all guest registration requests to enable proper session tracking and analytics.
href.x-autobe-specification: Session context field - NOT stored in hrm_platform_guests. Used to create hrm_platform_guest_sessions record with the URL the guest was accessing. Required field for session tracking.

referrer.description:
The referring URL that led the guest to the registration page.

This field captures the traffic source for session context tracking. It is stored in the hrm_platform_guest_sessions table (not in hrm_platform_guests) to maintain audit trail of the guest's navigation path.

Required for all guest registration requests to enable proper session tracking and analytics.
referrer.x-autobe-specification: Session context field - NOT stored in hrm_platform_guests. Used to create hrm_platform_guest_sessions record with the referring URL. Required field for session tracking.

ip.description:
Optional IP address of the guest for session context tracking.

This field captures the client's IP address for the guest session record. It is stored in the hrm_platform_guest_sessions table (not in hrm_platform_guests) for audit and security purposes.

Optional to support server-side rendering (SSR) scenarios where the client cannot directly know its own IP address. When omitted, the server automatically captures the IP from the request context as a fallback.
ip.x-autobe-specification: Session context field - NOT stored in hrm_platform_guests. Used to create hrm_platform_guest_sessions record with client IP address. Optional field to support SSR scenarios where client cannot know its own IP (server captures as fallback: body.ip ?? serverIp).

IHrmPlatformGuest.IJoin.description:
Guest registration request for creating a guest account and initial session.

This DTO is used when unauthenticated visitors access the platform. The device_fingerprint uniquely identifies the visitor's device and persists across browser sessions. If not provided, the server generates one from request characteristics.

The session context fields (href, referrer, ip) capture the request context for creating the initial guest session record in hrm_platform_guest_sessions. These fields enable session tracking and audit capabilities.
IHrmPlatformGuest.IJoin.x-autobe-specification: Request DTO for guest registration (IJoin). Maps device_fingerprint to hrm_platform_guests.device_fingerprint (optional, server generates if not provided). Session context fields (href, referrer, ip) are NOT stored in hrm_platform_guests but used to create hrm_platform_guest_sessions record. href and referrer are required for session tracking. ip is optional to support SSR scenarios where client cannot know its own IP (server captures as fallback).

search.description: Partial match filter for role name. Returns roles where the name contains this string (case-insensitive).
search.x-autobe-specification: Partial match LIKE query on hrm_platform_roles.name field. Case-insensitive. Optional - omit for no name filter.

is_built_in.description: Filter by role type. True returns only built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee). False returns only custom roles. Omit to return all roles.
is_built_in.x-autobe-specification: Exact boolean match on hrm_platform_roles.is_built_in. True for built-in roles, false for custom roles. Optional - omit for all roles.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts at 1. Defaults to 1 if not provided.
page.x-autobe-specification: Offset-based pagination page number. 1-indexed. Defaults to 1. Used with limit to calculate OFFSET = (page - 1) * limit.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Defaults to 20 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Number of records per page. Defaults to 20. Maximum 100. Used with page to calculate LIMIT clause.

IHrmPlatformRole.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for filtering and paginating the role list within the current organization.

This type defines the search criteria and pagination controls for retrieving roles. All parameters are optional - omitting a parameter means no filter is applied for that criterion. The server automatically scopes results to the current organization from the authenticated session.
IHrmPlatformRole.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Request DTO for querying hrm_platform_roles. search: partial match LIKE query on name field. is_built_in: exact boolean filter. page/limit: offset-based pagination. Server applies organization_id from session context and excludes soft-deleted roles.

IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an organization for list views and brief displays.

Contains essential identification and display fields: unique identifier, organization name, optional description and logo URL, currency code for financial operations, timezone for date/time handling, and creation timestamp. Used in paginated organization lists where users browse organizations they have access to.

This summary excludes internal configuration fields like fiscal_start_month and system timestamps like updated_at and deleted_at that are not needed for list display purposes. For complete organization details including all fields, use the full IHrmPlatformOrganization type.
IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organizations: id, name, description, logo_url, currency, timezone, created_at. Excludes: fiscal_start_month (internal config), updated_at, deleted_at. No relations - Organization is a root entity with no BELONGS-TO associations.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the organization membership record.

This UUID serves as the primary key for the membership junction table, uniquely identifying each association between a member and an organization.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.id. UUID format generated by database.

is_owner.description:
Indicates whether this member is the owner of the organization.

The owner has full access to organization settings and can manage organization lifecycle including deletion. Each organization must have exactly one owner at all times. Ownership can be transferred to another member through the membership update operation.
is_owner.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.is_owner. Boolean flag indicating ownership status. Each organization must have exactly one owner at all times.

created_at.description:

created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone. Automatically set by database on record creation.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the membership record was last updated.

Updated when membership properties change, such as ownership transfer or other membership modifications. Used for change tracking and cache invalidation. Helps identify recently modified memberships.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.updated_at. ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone. Automatically updated by database on any record modification.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the membership was soft deleted, or null if active.

Null indicates the membership is currently active. When set to a timestamp, the membership is considered deleted and the user is no longer associated with the organization. Soft delete preserves the record for audit purposes while removing the user's access to the organization.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.deleted_at. ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone. Nullable: null means active membership, timestamp means soft-deleted (member left or was removed from organization).

IHrmPlatformOrganizationMembership.description:
Complete organization membership record representing the association between a member and an organization.

This DTO includes the membership identifier, ownership status, and references to both the member and organization entities. The is_owner flag indicates whether this member has owner-level access to the organization. Each membership tracks creation and update timestamps, as well as soft delete status.

Membership records enable users to belong to multiple organizations simultaneously while maintaining distinct access levels per organization. The member and organization fields provide nested summary information for display purposes without requiring additional API calls.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationMembership.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships table. Columns: id, is_owner, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Relations: member via JOIN to hrm_platform_members (returns IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary), organization via JOIN to hrm_platform_organizations (returns IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary). FK columns hrm_platform_member_id and hrm_platform_organization_id are excluded from DTO as they are exposed as relation objects. Soft delete tracking via deleted_at (null = active, timestamp = deleted).

id.description:
Unique identifier for the role.

This UUID is automatically generated when the role is created and serves as the primary key for role lookups. Used in API paths when retrieving or updating a specific role.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.id. UUID format generated on role creation.

organization.description:
The organization that owns this role.

Every role belongs to exactly one organization in the multi-tenancy platform. This property provides the organization context including its ID, name, and basic settings. Used to identify which organization's permission scope this role applies to.
organization.x-autobe-specification: JOIN from hrm_platform_roles.organization_id to hrm_platform_organizations.id. Returns IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary with essential organization fields.

name.description:
Display name of the role shown throughout the platform interface.

For built-in roles, this is one of: 'Owner', 'Manager', or 'Employee'. For custom roles, this is defined by the organization owner during role creation. The name must be unique within the organization to avoid confusion when assigning roles to employees.
name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.name. Must be unique within the organization (enforced by @@unique([organization_id, name]) constraint).

isBuiltIn.description:
Flag indicating whether this is a system-provided built-in role.

Built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) are automatically created for each organization and cannot be deleted. Custom roles have this flag set to false and can be deleted if no employees are assigned to them. This flag also determines whether the role can be modified - built-in roles cannot be updated.
isBuiltIn.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.is_built_in. Boolean flag set to true for system-provided roles (Owner, Manager, Employee), false for custom roles.

description.description:
Optional explanation of the role's purpose and typical use cases.

Primarily used for custom roles to document their intended permissions and responsibilities. Built-in roles may have null descriptions as their purposes are well-defined (Owner has full access, Manager can manage employees and projects, Employee has basic access). Displayed in role management interfaces to help administrators understand role purposes.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.description. Nullable string - null for built-in roles or custom roles without description.

createdAt.description:
Timestamp when the role was created.

Automatically set by the system when the role record is first inserted. Built-in roles are created when the organization is created. Custom roles are created when an organization owner defines a new role. Used for audit trails and sorting roles by creation order.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format, automatically set on role creation.

updatedAt.description:
Timestamp when the role was last modified.

Automatically updated whenever the role's name, description, or permissions are changed. Built-in roles typically have the same createdAt and updatedAt values unless their permissions were modified. Custom roles show the most recent modification time. Used for change tracking and cache invalidation.
updatedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.updated_at. ISO 8601 date-time format, automatically updated on any role modification.

IHrmPlatformRole.description:
Complete role definition within an organization, including built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) and custom roles with configurable permission sets.

Roles define access control boundaries within an organization. Built-in roles are system-provided and cannot be deleted, while custom roles can be created by organization owners with specific permission combinations. Each role belongs to exactly one organization and has a unique name within that organization.

The organization property provides the parent organization context. The isBuiltIn flag indicates whether this is a system-provided role that cannot be modified or deleted. Custom roles can be edited and deleted if no employees are assigned to them.
IHrmPlatformRole.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles table with organization relation join. Fields: id, name, is_built_in, description, created_at, updated_at mapped directly. organization_id FK transformed to organization object via JOIN to hrm_platform_organizations. Excluded: deleted_at (soft delete system field), organization_id (replaced by organization object), rolePermissions/employees/employeeInvitations (has-many relations exposed via separate endpoints).

id.description:
Unique identifier for the permission record.

This UUID serves as the primary key for the permission in the database. It is used internally for role-permission assignments and API operations that reference specific permissions.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_permissions.id. UUID format primary key.

code.description:
Permission code identifier in 'domain:action' format.

This code uniquely identifies the permission throughout the system for authorization checks. The format follows a consistent pattern where the domain represents the resource area (e.g., 'org', 'employee', 'project', 'time', 'report') and the action represents the allowed operation (e.g., 'manage', 'view', 'approve').

Examples include 'org:manage' for organization settings management, 'employee:view' for viewing employee lists, and 'time:approve' for approving timesheets.
code.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_permissions.code. Unique constraint enforced at database level. Format: 'domain:action'.

description.description:
Human-readable explanation of what this permission allows.

This description helps administrators understand the purpose of each permission when creating or editing custom roles. It should clearly state what actions or resources the permission grants access to, making role configuration more intuitive.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_permissions.description. Human-readable text explaining the permission's purpose.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when this permission record was created.

This indicates when the permission was added to the system. Permissions are system-managed and populated during initial setup, so this timestamp reflects when the system was initialized or when new permissions were introduced in a platform update.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_permissions.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone.

IHrmPlatformPermission.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a permission definition for list views and role configuration interfaces.

This DTO contains the essential fields needed to display permissions when configuring custom roles. The code field identifies the permission in 'domain:action' format (e.g., 'employee:manage', 'project:view'), while the description provides a human-readable explanation of what the permission allows.

The id field serves as the unique identifier for internal operations, and created_at indicates when the permission was added to the system. This summary type is optimized for list views and dropdown selections, excluding audit fields like updated_at that are not needed for permission selection interfaces.
IHrmPlatformPermission.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_permissions table. Properties id, code, description, and created_at map directly to corresponding columns. Results are filtered to exclude soft-deleted records (deleted_at IS NULL) by default. The assignedRoles relation is excluded from this summary DTO as it is a has-many reverse relation not needed for list display.

name.description:
New name for the role.

This value replaces the existing role name. Must be unique within the organization - duplicate names are rejected. For custom roles, this is the display name shown in the UI when assigning roles to employees.
name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.name. Must be unique within organization per @@unique([organization_id, name]) constraint. Validated at operation level.

description.description:
Updated description explaining the role's purpose.

This value replaces the existing role description. Can be null for roles without a description. Primarily used for custom roles to document their intended permissions and responsibilities. Built-in roles may have null descriptions as their purposes are well-defined.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_roles.description. Nullable field - can be set to null to clear the description. Optional field primarily used for custom roles to document their intended permissions and responsibilities.

permissionIds.description:
Array of permission IDs to assign to this role.

This array completely replaces the role's existing permission set. Any permissions not included in the array will be removed from the role. Each ID must be a valid UUID referencing an existing permission in the system's permission master list.

An empty array results in a role with no permissions. All permissions in the array are validated to exist before the update is applied.
permissionIds.x-autobe-specification: Manages hrm_platform_role_permissions junction table. The array replaces the entire existing permission set - operation deletes all existing hrm_platform_role_permissions records for this role and inserts new records based on provided permissionIds. Each permissionId must exist in hrm_platform_permissions. Empty array results in role with no permissions.

IHrmPlatformRole.IUpdate.description:
Update request payload for modifying a custom role's configuration within an organization.

This DTO is used to update an existing custom role's name, description, and assigned permissions. The request replaces the entire permission set - any permissions not included in the permissionIds array will be removed from the role.

Built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) cannot be updated using this DTO. Attempts to modify built-in roles are rejected with a 403 error at the operation level. The role name must be unique within the organization.
IHrmPlatformRole.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_roles table for mutable fields (name, description). Permission assignment managed via hrm_platform_role_permissions junction table - the permissionIds array replaces the entire existing permission set. Excluded: id (path parameter), organization_id (resolved from JWT context), is_built_in (immutable system flag), created_at/updated_at/deleted_at (system-managed timestamps), organization relation (FK excluded), rolePermissions/employees/employeeInvitations (reverse relations not in update body). Validation: name must be unique within organization per @@unique([organization_id, name]) constraint. Built-in roles (is_built_in=true) are rejected at operation level with 403 error.

name.description:
Department name for identification within the organization.

Must be unique within the parent organization to avoid ambiguity in employee listings and organizational charts. Used for display in navigation, filters, and department selection interfaces.

This field is optional in Update operations to support partial updates. When provided, the uniqueness constraint is enforced at the database level with a composite unique index on (hrm_platform_organization_id, name).
name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_departments.name. String type. Backend validates uniqueness within the organization (hrm_platform_organization_id) via composite unique index. Optional in Update DTO for partial update support.

description.description:
Optional description of the department's purpose and responsibilities.

Provides context about the department's function within the organization. Displayed in department detail views and organizational documentation. Can be null for departments without detailed descriptions.

This field is optional in Update operations. Can be set to a string value to add or update the description, or set to null to clear an existing description.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_departments.description. Nullable string type (oneOf: string, null). Optional field for department purpose details. No validation constraints beyond string type.

parentDepartmentId.description:
References the parent department for hierarchical organization structure.

Enables one level of department nesting (parent-child relationship). Top-level departments have this field set to null. Child departments cannot have their own children, enforcing the one-level hierarchy constraint.

This field is optional in Update operations. Can be set to a UUID to assign or reassign a parent department, or set to null to make the department a top-level department. When provided, the referenced parent department must belong to the same organization to maintain data isolation boundaries.
parentDepartmentId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_departments.parent_department_id. Nullable UUID string format (oneOf: string with format uuid, null). References another department within the same organization for one-level hierarchy. Backend validates: if provided, parent department must exist and belong to same organization.

IHrmPlatformDepartment.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating an existing department's properties within an organization.

This DTO contains only the mutable fields that can be modified through the update operation. All properties are optional to support partial updates — only provided fields will be updated while others remain unchanged.

The name field must remain unique within the parent organization. If parentDepartmentId is provided, it must reference a department within the same organization to maintain data isolation boundaries. System-generated fields (id, timestamps) and organization context are excluded as they are managed automatically or derived from the URL path.
IHrmPlatformDepartment.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_departments table. Contains mutable fields only: name, description, parent_department_id. All properties optional for partial update support (PATCH semantics). Backend validates: name uniqueness within organization (composite unique index on hrm_platform_organization_id, name), parent_department_id belongs to same organization if provided. System fields (id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) and organization context (hrm_platform_organization_id, organization relation) are excluded as immutable or derived from path parameters. Has-many relations (childDepartments, employees, employeeInvitations) and belongs-to relation (parentDepartment) are excluded as managed through separate endpoints or represented as FK columns.

id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.id. UUID format.

organization.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via JOIN from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.hrm_platform_organization_id to hrm_platform_organizations.id. Returns IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary.

Timestamp when the membership was created.

Records when the user joined or was added to the organization. This field is immutable after creation and is used for audit trails, sorting memberships by join date, and determining membership tenure. Formatted as ISO 8601 date-time string with timezone information.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationMembership.ISumm.description:
Summary representation of an organization membership showing the association between a member and an organization with ownership status.

This DTO is optimized for list views and includes only essential display fields. The member and organization properties provide context about who belongs to which organization, while isOwner indicates ownership status. The createdAt field shows when the membership was established.

Used in paginated membership lists where full detail is not required. For complete membership information including all timestamps, use the full IHrmPlatformOrganizationMembership type.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationMembership.ISumm.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organization_memberships: id, is_owner, created_at. department_id.description:
Filter employees by department assignment.

When provided, returns only employees assigned to the specified department. When null or omitted, includes all employees regardless of department assignment (including those without a department).
department_id.x-autobe-specification: Query filter mapping to hrm_platform_employees.department_id column. Exact match filter. Nullable: null or omitted matches all departments including unassigned.

employment_type.description:
Filter employees by employment classification.

Valid values are full-time, part-time, contractor, or intern. When provided, returns only employees with matching employment type. When omitted, includes all employment types.
employment_type.x-autobe-specification: Query filter mapping to hrm_platform_employees.employment_type column. Exact match filter. Enum values: full-time, part-time, contractor, intern.

status.description:
Filter employees by activation status.

Valid values are active or deactivated. Active employees can log time and submit timesheets. Deactivated employees cannot but their historical data is preserved. When omitted, includes both active and deactivated employees.
status.x-autobe-specification: Query filter mapping to hrm_platform_employees.status column. Exact match filter. Enum values: active, deactivated.

search.description:
Search employees by position title using fuzzy matching.

Performs trigram-based similarity search on the position field. Matches partial text case-insensitively. For example, searching 'engineer' matches 'Software Engineer', 'Senior Engineer', etc. Uses PostgreSQL gin_trgm_ops index for performance.
search.x-autobe-specification: Trigram-based fuzzy search on hrm_platform_employees.position field using gin_trgm_ops index. Case-insensitive partial matching.

cursor.description:

Obtained from the previous page's response metadata. When null or omitted, returns the first page. Used for efficient cursor-based pagination through large employee lists.

Maximum number of employee records to return per page.

Controls page size for pagination. Valid values range from 1 to 100. If not provided, defaults to 20 records per page. Useful for controlling response payload size and UI rendering.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum records per page. Range: 1-100. Default: 20 if not provided.

Specifies which page of results to return. Page numbering starts from 1, so the first page is page 1. If omitted, null, or undefined, defaults to page 1. Requesting a page beyond the available range returns an empty data array with valid pagination metadata.
page.x-autobe-specification: 1-indexed page number. Minimum: 1. Defaults to 1 if not provided. Used alongside cursor for pagination navigation.

IHrmPlatformEmployee.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for retrieving a paginated list of employees with optional filtering and search capabilities.

This type defines the query criteria for the employee listing endpoint. All properties are optional, allowing callers to retrieve unfiltered results or apply specific filters as needed. The search property performs trigram-based fuzzy matching on the employee position field.

Pagination uses cursor-based navigation for efficient handling of large result sets. The cursor value is obtained from the previous page's response metadata.
IHrmPlatformEmployee.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query parameters for employee listing. Maps to hrm_platform_employees filters: department_id (exact match), employment_type (enum: full-time|part-time|contractor|intern), status (enum: active|deactivated), search (trigram on position field). Pagination: cursor (UUID from previous page), limit (1-100, default 20). All fields optional - empty request returns first page with default limit.

name.description:
Organization display name shown throughout the platform interface.

This is the primary identifier for the organization visible to users in navigation, reports, and organization switching interfaces. Must be unique within the platform to avoid confusion when users belong to multiple organizations.
name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organizations.name. Validates non-empty string. Used as primary organization identifier throughout the platform interface.

description.description:

logo_url.description:
URL to the organization's logo image for branding purposes.

Displayed in the application header, emails, and reports. Supports standard image formats (PNG, JPG, SVG). Can be null if no logo has been uploaded.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 currency code for financial tracking and reporting.

Examples: USD, EUR, KRW, JPY, GBP. Used for displaying pay rates, project budgets, and financial reports. Must be a valid 3-letter currency code.
currency.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organizations.currency. Validates ISO 4217 currency code (3 uppercase letters like USD, EUR, KRW). Used for financial reporting and pay rate displays.

timezone.description:
IANA timezone identifier for date/time operations within the organization.

Examples: Asia/Seoul, America/New_York, Europe/London. Used to interpret dates and times for timesheets, timelogs, and deadlines. Ensures consistent time handling across all organization data.
timezone.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organizations.timezone. Validates IANA timezone identifier format (e.g., Asia/Seoul, America/New_York, Europe/London). Used to interpret dates and times for timesheets, timelogs, and deadlines.

fiscal_start_month.description:
Month number (1-12) when the organization's fiscal year begins.

Used for financial reporting and accounting periods. January=1, December=12. Common values: 1 (calendar year), 4 (Q1 start), 7 (mid-year). Required for proper fiscal period calculations.
fiscal_start_month.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_organizations.fiscal_start_month. Validates integer between 1-12 (January=1, December=12). Used for financial reporting and accounting period calculations.

IHrmPlatformOrganization.IUpdate.description:
Organization settings update request containing mutable configuration fields for modifying an organization's business settings.

All properties are optional to support partial updates. Only provided fields will be modified, while unspecified fields retain their current values. This enables clients to update individual settings without sending the complete organization object.

The name field updates the organization display name shown throughout the platform. The description provides organizational context and purpose. The logo_url sets the branding image URL for the organization interface. The currency configures the ISO 4217 currency code for financial reporting and pay rate displays. The timezone sets the IANA timezone identifier for consistent date/time interpretation across timesheets and timelogs. The fiscal_start_month defines the fiscal year start month (1-12) for accounting period calculations.
IHrmPlatformOrganization.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_organizations update operation. All fields optional for partial update via PUT /hrmPlatform/member/organizations/{organizationId}. Backend validates: name non-empty string, currency is valid ISO 4217 code (3 uppercase letters), timezone is valid IANA timezone identifier, fiscal_start_month is integer 1-12, logo_url is valid URI or null. Backend automatically sets updated_at timestamp on successful update. Requesting user must belong to the organization and have org:manage permission.

id.description:

deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_user_profiles.deleted_at. Nullable timestamp - null means profile is active, non-null means profile is soft deleted.

IHrmPlatformUserProfile.description:
Global user profile containing display name, avatar image URL, and phone number shared across all organizations.

Each profile belongs to exactly one member account and provides identity information that persists regardless of which organization context the user is working in. The profile contains personal presentation data (display name, avatar) and contact information (phone number) that remains consistent as users switch between organizations or join new ones.

The member property references the associated member account. The phone_number field is optional and may be null if the user has not provided contact information. The deleted_at field indicates soft deletion status - null means the profile is active.

search.description:
Optional text filter for searching organizations by name.

IHrmPlatformEmployeeInvitation.IRequest.description:

This type defines the search criteria and pagination parameters for querying employee invitations within the current organization. All fields are optional, allowing users to browse all invitations or apply specific filters.

The {@link search} field performs a partial match on the invited employee's email address. The {@link status} field filters by invitation lifecycle state. The {@link department_id} filters by department assignment. The {@link employment_type} filters by employment classification.

IHrmPlatformTask.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for filtering, sorting, and paginating tasks within a project.

This type defines the search criteria for retrieving tasks from a specific project. All fields are optional, allowing flexible queries from unfiltered browsing to highly specific searches.

**Filters**: Use status to filter by workflow state, priority for urgency level, and assignedEmployeeId to find tasks assigned to a specific employee or null for unassigned backlog items. The search field performs text matching against task titles and descriptions.

**Sorting**: Control result ordering with sort (field name) and sortDirection (ascending or descending). Supported sort fields are dueDate, priority, and createdAt.

**Pagination**: Uses cursor-based pagination with limit for page size (1-100) and cursor for navigating through result pages. Page parameter provides 1-indexed page number support.

IHrmPlatformProject.description:
Complete project record with all attributes including identification, timeline, budget, and status information.

Projects are the core unit of work management within an organization, containing tasks and assigned team members. Each project belongs to exactly one organization for multi-tenancy isolation. The project lifecycle status (active, archived, completed) controls whether new timelogs can be recorded against it.

This Read DTO includes all project attributes: name for identification, color code for UI visual distinction, optional description for context, budget hours for capacity planning, optional start and end dates for timeline tracking, and system timestamps. IHrmPlatformEmployeeContract.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and filtering employee contracts with pagination support.

This type defines the search criteria for querying employee contract records. All fields are optional, allowing flexible filtering combinations. Results are paginated and can be sorted by various fields.

Use {@link employee_id} to filter contracts for a specific employee. Date range filters ({@link start_date_from}, {@link start_date_to}, {@link end_date_from}, {@link end_date_to}) enable temporal queries. The {@link pay_period} field filters by compensation frequency (hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly). The {@link status} field distinguishes between active contracts (ongoing, end_date is null) and historical contracts (ended, end_date is set).

Pagination is controlled via {@link page} and {@link limit} parameters. Custom sorting is available through {@link sort} and {@link direction} fields.

Maps to hrm_platform_employee_contracts table with optional filters: employee_id (JOIN with hrm_platform_employees), start_date range, end_date range (null means active), pay_period enum filter, status (active=end_date IS NULL, historical=end_date IS NOT NULL). Pagination: page (default 1), limit (default 20, max 100). Sorting: sort field name and direction (asc/desc, default desc on created_at).

IHrmPlatformTaskHistory.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for querying task history entries with filtering, sorting, and pagination options.

Used to retrieve the audit trail of status changes for a specific task. All filters are optional - omitting them returns all history entries with default pagination (newest first).

Date range filtering applies to the {@link created_at} timestamp. Status filters match exact status values from the task workflow: 'open', 'in-progress', 'completed', 'closed'. Member filtering allows viewing changes made by a specific user.
IHrmPlatformTaskHistory.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_task_histories query filters. dateFrom/dateTo filter created_at range. oldStatus/newStatus filter status transition values. memberId filters by hrm_platform_member_id. page/limit for pagination (default page=1, limit=20). sort field defaults to 'created_at', order defaults to 'desc' (newest first). All fields optional - empty request returns all history for the task with default pagination.

week_start_date.description: The Monday date marking the start of the timesheet week. Must be a valid Monday date - the system validates this constraint. The week end date is automatically calculated as this date plus 6 days (Sunday).

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ICreate.description:
Request payload for creating a new draft timesheet.

Contains only the week start date (Monday) for the timesheet period. The employee ownership is automatically derived from the authenticated user's context, and the week end date is calculated as six days after the start date. New timesheets are created in draft status, allowing the employee to manage timelogs before submission.

The week_start_date must be a Monday - the system validates this constraint and rejects requests with invalid dates.
IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_timesheets table. Only week_start_date is accepted from client. employee_id derived from authenticated member's employee record in current organization. week_end_date calculated as week_start_date + 6 days. status initialized to 'draft'. All other fields (reviewer_id, submitted_at, reviewed_at, rejection_reason, timestamps) are system-managed.

IHrmPlatformTask.description:
Complete task entity representing a work item within a project.

This DTO includes all task attributes: identification (id), content (title, description), workflow tracking (status, priority), planning estimates (estimated_hours, due_date), and lifecycle timestamps (created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). It provides relational context through the parent project reference, optional employee assignment, optional parent task for subtask hierarchy, and nested subtasks array.

Task status tracks workflow progression through four states: open (new/unstarted), in-progress (actively being worked on), completed (work finished), and closed (finalized and archived). Priority indicates urgency with four levels: low, medium, high, and urgent. The subtasks array supports one-level hierarchy - subtasks cannot have their own subtasks.

This Read DTO is used for retrieving complete task details via GET /hrmPlatform/member/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}. For task creation use IHrmPlatformTask.ICreate, for updates use IHrmPlatformTask.IUpdate, and for list views use IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary.
IHrmPlatformTask.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks table with JOINs for relations. Columns: id, title, description, status, priority, estimated_hours, due_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Relations: project via JOIN to hrm_platform_projects on hrm_platform_project_id, assignedEmployee via LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_employees on assigned_employee_id (nullable), parentTask via self-join to hrm_platform_tasks on parent_task_id (nullable). Composition: subtasks array via recursive query on parent_task_id. Excludes: histories, timelogs, timers (accessible via separate endpoints /tasks/{taskId}/histories, /timelogs, /timers).

IHrmPlatformTaskHistory.description:
Represents a single task status change event in the immutable audit trail.

Each history entry captures who made the status transition, when it occurred, and what the status changed from and to. This enables transparency into task workflow progression and accountability for status changes.

History entries are append-only and cannot be modified or deleted, ensuring complete audit trail integrity. Used for viewing task history timelines and auditing who changed task status.

FK columns hrm_platform_task_id and hrm_platform_member_id are excluded as they are exposed through relation objects. Query by historyId with validation that entry belongs to specified taskId and projectId for access control.

IHrmPlatformTimelog.ICreate.description:
Request payload for creating a new timelog entry.

Represents a discrete period of work performed by the authenticated employee on a specific project. Timelogs are the foundational units of time tracking, later aggregated into weekly timesheets for approval workflows.

**Required Fields**

The date specifies when the work was performed (calendar date). The duration_minutes records total work time in minutes (must be positive). The hrm_platform_project_id references the project where work was performed (must be a project the employee is assigned to).

**Optional Fields**

The hrm_platform_task_id optionally references a specific task within the project for finer granularity. The description provides context about what work was performed. The billable flag indicates whether this time is billable to a client (defaults to true if omitted).

**Validation**

Backend validates that the employee is active and assigned to the specified project. If a task is provided, it must belong to the selected project. The date cannot be in the future, and duration must be greater than zero minutes.
IHrmPlatformTimelog.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Maps to hrm_platform_timelogs table for Create operation. User-provided fields: date, duration_minutes, hrm_platform_project_id, hrm_platform_task_id (nullable), description (nullable), billable. Excluded: id (UUID auto-generated), hrm_platform_employee_id (resolved from authenticated member context), hrm_platform_timesheet_id (null on creation), created_at/updated_at/deleted_at (system timestamps). Backend validates: employee is active and assigned to project, task belongs to project if provided, duration_minutes > 0, date not in future. Defaults billable to true if not provided.

IHrmPlatformTimelog.description:
Complete timelog record representing a discrete period of work performed by an employee on a specific project with optional task assignment.

Timelogs capture the fundamental unit of time tracking with date, duration, and context. Each timelog belongs to exactly one employee and one project, with optional references to a task and timesheet.

The employee reference identifies who performed the work. The project reference identifies which project the work was for. The optional task reference provides finer granularity for task-level tracking. The optional timesheet reference indicates which weekly timesheet includes this timelog (null if not yet assigned).

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.description:
Weekly timesheet entity aggregating timelog entries for approval workflow.

A timesheet represents a collection of work hours logged by an employee within a specific week period (Monday to Sunday). Timesheets progress through a workflow: draft → submitted → approved or rejected. Employees create draft timesheets, submit them for review, and managers with time:approve permission can approve or reject with reasons.

The {@link employee} field references the timesheet owner. The {@link reviewer} field is populated when the timesheet is approved or rejected. The {@link status} field indicates the current workflow state. The {@link timelogs} array contains all time entries included in this timesheet period.

Approved timesheets lock all included timelogs from further editing. Rejected timesheets return to draft status with a {@link rejectionReason} explaining required corrections.

Composition: timelogs array via hrm_platform_timelogs where timesheet_id matches (include as IHrmPlatformTimelog.ISummary[]).

- rejected → draft: Employee modifies and resubmits rejected timesheet
