IHrmPlatformEmployeeInvitation.description:
Complete employee invitation record representing a pending or processed invitation for a user to join an organization as an employee.

This entity captures the full lifecycle of an employee invitation from creation through acceptance, expiration, or cancellation. It includes the invited email address, assigned role, optional department assignment, position title, employment type classification, and all lifecycle timestamps.

The organization field references the organization that sent the invitation. The invitedBy field identifies the member who initiated the invitation. The role field specifies the role to be assigned upon acceptance. The department field is optional and specifies the department assignment if provided.

The status field tracks the invitation state: 'pending' (awaiting acceptance), 'accepted' (user signed up and joined), 'expired' (past expiration date), or 'cancelled' (manually cancelled). The employment_type field specifies the employment classification: 'full-time', 'part-time', 'contractor', or 'intern'.
IHrmPlatformEmployeeInvitation.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_employee_invitations table. Columns: id, email, position, employment_type, status, invited_at, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Relations: organization via JOIN to hrm_platform_organizations on organization_id, invitedBy via JOIN to hrm_platform_members on invited_by, role via JOIN to hrm_platform_roles on role_id, department via LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_departments on department_id. employment_type enum: full-time, part-time, contractor, intern. status enum: pending, accepted, expired, cancelled. accepted_at and deleted_at are nullable. department is nullable (optional assignment).

id.description:
Unique identifier for the timer session.

This is the primary key that uniquely identifies each timer record in the system. Used for timer management operations such as editing, stopping, or discarding a running timer.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.id. UUID format.

started_at.description:
Timestamp when the timer session was started.

Records the exact moment the employee initiated time tracking. This value is immutable and used to calculate the duration when the timer is stopped. For active timers, this is also used to compute the elapsed time displayed in real-time.
started_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.started_at. ISO 8601 date-time format. Immutable after timer creation.

stopped_at.description:
Timestamp when the timer session was stopped.

Null value indicates the timer is currently running (active). When set, the timer is considered complete and the duration is calculated as stopped_at minus started_at. Only one timer per employee can have stopped_at as null at any time.
stopped_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.stopped_at. ISO 8601 date-time format. Null indicates the timer is currently running (active).

description.description:
Optional description of the work being tracked.

Employees can add notes about what specific work they are doing during this timer session. This field is editable while the timer is running to allow updates as work context changes. Null value indicates no description was provided.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers.description. Nullable string. Editable while timer is running.

project.description:
The project being tracked by this timer.

Every timer must be associated with a project to categorize the work being tracked. The project must be one that the employee is assigned to as a project member. This reference provides project context including name and color for UI display.
project.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via JOIN from hrm_platform_timers.hrm_platform_project_id to hrm_platform_projects.id. Returns IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary.

task.description:
The optional task being tracked by this timer.

Tasks provide granular tracking within a project. This field is nullable because employees may track time at the project level without specifying a particular task. When provided, the task must belong to the associated project.
task.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via LEFT JOIN from hrm_platform_timers.hrm_platform_task_id to hrm_platform_tasks.id. Returns IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary or null. Task must belong to the associated project.

status.description:
Current status of the timer session.

Indicates whether the timer is currently running or has been completed. Value is 'active' when stopped_at is null (timer is running), and 'completed' when stopped_at has a value (timer has been stopped). This computed field provides a convenient status indicator for UI display.
status.x-autobe-specification: Computed property: 'active' if stopped_at is null, 'completed' if stopped_at is not null. Not stored in database - derived from stopped_at field at query time.

duration.description:
Total duration of the timer session in minutes.

Represents the total tracked time for completed timers. Calculated as the difference between stopped_at and started_at, converted to minutes and rounded to the nearest integer. Null for active timers that have not been stopped yet.
duration.x-autobe-specification: Computed property: duration in minutes as integer, calculated as (stopped_at - started_at) / 60000, rounded to nearest minute. Null if timer is active (stopped_at is null). Not stored in database.

elapsedTime.description:
Elapsed time for active timers in seconds.

Shows the running duration for active timers, enabling real-time UI updates. Calculated as the difference between the current server time and started_at, in seconds. Null for completed timers where the final duration is available instead.
elapsedTime.x-autobe-specification: Computed property: elapsed time in seconds as integer, calculated as (now() - started_at) / 1000. Null if timer is completed (stopped_at is not null). Not stored in database - computed at query time using current server timestamp.

IHrmPlatformTimer.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a timer session for list display and real-time tracking views.

Provides essential timer information including the associated project, optional task, timing details, and current status. Active timers (stopped_at is null) show elapsed time since start, while completed timers show the final duration.

The project field references the project being tracked. The task field is optional and references the specific task if one was selected during timer start. The status field indicates whether the timer is currently running (active) or has been stopped (completed). Duration represents the total tracked time in minutes for completed timers. ElapsedTime shows the running duration in seconds for active timers, enabling real-time UI updates.
IHrmPlatformTimer.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timers: id, started_at, stopped_at, description. Relations: project via JOIN to hrm_platform_projects (ISummary), task via LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_tasks (ISummary, nullable). Computed: status ('active' if stopped_at is null, 'completed' otherwise), duration (minutes as integer, stopped_at - started_at, null if active), elapsedTime (seconds as integer, now() - started_at, null if completed). Excluded: hrm_platform_employee_id (actor identity from JWT), hrm_platform_project_id and hrm_platform_task_id (FK columns exposed as relation objects), created_at and updated_at (system timestamps not needed for summary), employee relation (timer owner is authenticated user from JWT context).

id.description:
Unique identifier for the activity log entry.

Auto-generated UUID assigned when the log entry is created. Used for referencing specific audit trail records.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_logs.id. UUID format.

actionType.description:
Categorizes the type of action performed using dot-notation format.

Examples include employee.invited, employee.deactivated, contract.created, project.archived, task.status_changed, timesheet.approved, timesheet.rejected, role.assigned. Used for filtering and grouping audit events by action category.
actionType.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_logs.action_type. Dot-notation format (domain.action).

targetEntityType.description:
Identifies the type of entity that was affected by the logged action.

Common values include employee, contract, project, task, timesheet, role. Enables filtering logs by the type of entity that was modified or acted upon.
targetEntityType.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_logs.target_entity_type. Identifies the entity type affected by the action.

targetEntityId.description:
References the specific entity instance that was affected by the action.

The ID format depends on the target_entity_type. Allows navigating to the affected record when it still exists. Useful for audit trail navigation and debugging.
targetEntityId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_logs.target_entity_id. UUID format referencing the affected entity instance.

details.description:
Structured metadata about the action in JSON-like format.

Contains contextual information such as old/new values, reasons, or additional attributes. Examples: {"old_status":"draft","new_status":"submitted"} for status changes, or {"email":"user@example.com"} for invitation events. Parsing required to extract individual fields.
details.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_logs.details. JSON-like string containing contextual information about the action.

createdAt.description:
Timestamp when the logged action occurred.

Automatically set when the activity log entry is created. Used for chronological ordering and date range filtering in audit log queries. Format follows ISO 8601 standard with timezone information.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_logs.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone.

member.description:
The member who performed the logged action.

References the authenticated user account that triggered the audit event. Contains member identification information including email and account status. Essential for accountability and audit trail purposes.
member.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via JOIN from hrm_platform_activity_logs.hrm_platform_member_id to hrm_platform_members.id. Returns IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary with member identification fields.

organization.description:
The organization that owns this audit log entry.

All activity logs are scoped to a specific organization for multi-tenancy data isolation. Contains organization identification information including name and settings. Ensures users only see audit events from their current organization context.
organization.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via JOIN from hrm_platform_activity_logs.hrm_platform_organization_id to hrm_platform_organizations.id. Returns IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary with organization identification fields.

IHrmPlatformActivityLog.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an activity log entry for audit trail list displays.

Captures the essential information about a logged action including what action was performed, which entity was affected, who performed it, and when it occurred. Optimized for list views showing organization activity history.

The member property references the user who performed the action. The organization property indicates the organization scope. The details field contains contextual metadata about the action in JSON-like format.
IHrmPlatformActivityLog.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_logs table. Scalar fields: id, action_type→actionType (camelCase), target_entity_type→targetEntityType (camelCase), target_entity_id→targetEntityId (camelCase), details, created_at→createdAt (camelCase). Relations: member via JOIN on hrm_platform_member_id to hrm_platform_members.id (returns IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary), organization via JOIN on hrm_platform_organization_id to hrm_platform_organizations.id (returns IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary). All fields required as DB has no nullable columns. Used for paginated audit trail list views accessed via GET /hrmPlatform/member/activity-logs.

hoursToday.description:
Total hours logged by the employee today.

Calculated by summing the duration_minutes from all timelog entries where the date matches the current day. The sum is converted from minutes to hours by dividing by 60.

This value updates in real-time as new timelogs are created or existing ones are modified. If the employee has not logged any time today, this field returns 0.
hoursToday.x-autobe-specification: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id equals current employee AND DATE(date) equals current date (midnight UTC to midnight UTC). Result divided by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist for today.

hoursThisWeek.description:
Total hours logged by the employee in the current week (Monday to Sunday).

Calculated by summing the duration_minutes from all timelog entries within the current week period. Week boundaries are determined using the organization's timezone setting, starting from Monday 00:00 through Sunday 23:59.

This value provides employees with visibility into their weekly time accumulation, useful for tracking against expected working hours or timesheet submission requirements. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist for the current week.
hoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id equals current employee AND date falls within current week (Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 in organization timezone). Result divided by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Week boundaries determined by organization timezone setting.

activeTimer.description:
Currently running timer session if the employee has an active timer, or null if no timer is running.

When present, this object contains the timer's identifier, start timestamp, associated project and optional task, work description, and calculated elapsed time in seconds. The status field indicates 'active' for running timers.

Employees can have at most one active timer at a time. If no timer is currently running, this field returns null. The elapsed time is calculated dynamically from the started_at timestamp to the current moment.
activeTimer.x-autobe-specification: SELECT from hrm_platform_timers WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id equals current employee AND stopped_at IS NULL. Returns IHrmPlatformTimer.ISummary with id, started_at, stopped_at, description, project, task, status ('active'), duration (null for active), and elapsedTime (seconds since started_at). Returns null if no active timer exists. Each employee can have at most one active timer.

recentTimelogs.description:
The five most recent timelog entries created by the employee, ordered by creation timestamp descending.

Each timelog entry includes the work date, duration in minutes, optional description, billable status, and references to the associated project and optional task. Employee information is included for context.

This list provides quick access to recent time entries for review or reference. The array is ordered with the most recently created timelog first. If the employee has no timelog entries, an empty array is returned.
recentTimelogs.x-autobe-specification: SELECT id, date, duration_minutes, description, billable, employee (ISummary), project (ISummary), task (ISummary, nullable) FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id equals current employee. ORDER BY created_at DESC. LIMIT 5. Returns array of IHrmPlatformTimelog.ISummary. Empty array if no timelogs exist.

pendingTimesheet.description:
The timesheet for the current week if one exists with draft or submitted status, or null if no timesheet has been created for this week.

When present, this object contains the timesheet's week period (Monday to Sunday), current workflow status, total hours aggregated from included timelogs, and references to the employee and optional reviewer. Submission and review timestamps indicate workflow progress.

This field helps employees track their timesheet submission status. A null value indicates no timesheet exists for the current week, meaning the employee may need to create one. Timesheets with approved or rejected status are not included in this field.
pendingTimesheet.x-autobe-specification: SELECT id, week_start_date, week_end_date, status, employee (ISummary), reviewer (ISummary, nullable), submitted_at, reviewed_at FROM hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE employee_id equals current employee AND week_start_date equals current week's Monday AND status IN ('draft', 'submitted'). Returns IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ISummary or null if no timesheet exists for current week. Total hours computed from included timelogs.

assignedTasks.description:
Tasks currently assigned to the employee with status 'open' or 'in-progress', ordered by priority (urgent first) then due date ascending.

Each task includes the title, current workflow status, priority level, optional due date, estimated hours, and references to the assigned employee and optional parent task. This provides employees with a focused view of their active work items.

Tasks are sorted to surface the most urgent and time-sensitive items first. Urgent priority tasks appear before high, medium, and low priority tasks. Within the same priority level, tasks with earlier due dates appear first. Tasks without due dates appear after dated tasks at the same priority level.
assignedTasks.x-autobe-specification: SELECT id, title, status, priority, due_date, estimated_hours, assignedEmployee (ISummary, nullable), parentTask (ISummary, nullable), created_at FROM hrm_platform_tasks WHERE assigned_employee_id equals current employee AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress'). ORDER BY priority DESC (urgent first), then due_date ASC. Returns array of IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary. Empty array if no tasks match criteria.

IHrmPlatformDashboard.IPersonal.description:
Personal dashboard overview for the currently authenticated employee, aggregating time tracking activity and assigned work items.

This response type provides employees with a comprehensive snapshot of their work activity within the selected organization context. The dashboard combines computed time totals, real-time timer status, recent time entries, timesheet workflow state, and pending task assignments into a single unified view.

All data is scoped to the authenticated employee's record and the currently selected organization. Computed fields (hoursToday, hoursThisWeek) aggregate from timelog entries. The activeTimer field reflects any currently running timer session. Recent timelogs provide quick access to the last five time entries. The pendingTimesheet field indicates whether a timesheet exists for the current week and its approval status. Assigned tasks list shows work items with open or in-progress status, ordered by urgency.
IHrmPlatformDashboard.IPersonal.x-autobe-specification: Aggregation DTO combining data from multiple tables for employee dashboard display. 1) hoursToday: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id=current AND DATE(date)=CURRENT_DATE, divided by 60 for hours. 2) hoursThisWeek: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id=current AND date BETWEEN week_start(Monday 00:00) AND week_end(Sunday 23:59) in organization timezone, divided by 60. 3) activeTimer: SELECT id, started_at, stopped_at, description, project, task FROM hrm_platform_timers WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id=current AND stopped_at IS NULL, returns IHrmPlatformTimer.ISummary or null. 4) recentTimelogs: SELECT id, date, duration_minutes, description, billable, employee, project, task FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id=current ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5, returns array of IHrmPlatformTimelog.ISummary. 5) pendingTimesheet: SELECT id, week_start_date, week_end_date, status, employee, reviewer, submitted_at, reviewed_at FROM hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE employee_id=current AND week_start_date=current week's Monday AND status IN ('draft','submitted'), returns IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ISummary or null. 6) assignedTasks: SELECT id, title, status, priority, due_date, estimated_hours, assignedEmployee, parentTask, created_at FROM hrm_platform_tasks WHERE assigned_employee_id=current AND status IN ('open','in-progress') ORDER BY priority DESC, due_date ASC, returns array of IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary. All queries enforce organization context via JOIN through employee record to filter by organization_id.

activeEmployeesCount.description:
The total number of active employees in the organization.

This count includes only employees with status 'active' and excludes deactivated employees and soft-deleted records. The value is computed in real-time from the hrm_platform_employees table filtered by the current organization context.
activeEmployeesCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_employees: COUNT(*) WHERE organization_id = ? AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL. Returns 0 when no active employees exist.

totalHoursThisWeek.description:
The total hours logged by all employees during the current week.

This value represents the sum of all timelog durations from Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 in the organization's configured timezone. The duration is calculated in minutes from hrm_platform_timelogs and converted to hours. Returns 0 when no timelogs exist for the current week.
totalHoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs joined with hrm_platform_employees: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE employees.organization_id = ? AND timelogs.date BETWEEN week_start (Monday 00:00) AND week_end (Sunday 23:59) in organization timezone. Returns 0 when no timelogs exist for the current week.

pendingTimesheetsCount.description:
The number of timesheets awaiting approval in the organization.

This count includes only timesheets with status 'submitted' that have not yet been approved or rejected. The value is computed by joining hrm_platform_timesheets with hrm_platform_employees to filter by organization context. Returns 0 when no timesheets are pending.
pendingTimesheetsCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timesheets joined with hrm_platform_employees: COUNT(*) WHERE employees.organization_id = ? AND timesheets.status = 'submitted' AND timesheets.deleted_at IS NULL. Returns 0 when no pending timesheets exist.

projectsOverBudget.description:
List of projects that have consumed 80% or more of their budgeted hours.

This array includes only projects with a defined budget_hours value where the ratio of actual logged hours to budgeted hours is at least 0.8 (80%). Each entry contains the project identifier, name, budgeted hours, actual hours logged this week, and the utilization percentage. Returns an empty array when no projects exceed the threshold.
projectsOverBudget.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_projects with timelog aggregation: For each project with budget_hours > 0, calculate actual_hours from hrm_platform_timelogs for the current week. Filter WHERE (actual_hours / budget_hours) >= 0.8. Returns array of objects with id, name, budgetHours, actualHours, and utilizationPercentage. Returns empty array when no projects exceed 80% budget utilization.

topEmployees.description:
The top five employees ranked by hours logged in the current week.

This array lists employees sorted by total time logged during the current week (Monday to Sunday), limited to the top 5 performers. Each entry includes the employee identifier, display name from their user profile, and total minutes logged. Returns an empty array when no timelogs exist for the current week.
topEmployees.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs grouped by employee_id: SUM(duration_minutes) for current week, ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5. Joined with hrm_platform_employees and hrm_platform_user_profiles for displayName. Returns array of objects with employeeId, displayName, and totalMinutes. Returns empty array when no timelogs exist.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.description:
Organization dashboard containing aggregated statistics for active employees, weekly hours logged, pending timesheet count, projects with high budget utilization, and top performing employees by time logged.

This dashboard provides an at-a-glance overview of key organizational metrics and activity indicators. All data is scoped to the currently selected organization context and requires the report:view permission to access.

The activeEmployeesCount shows the total number of employees with active status. The totalHoursThisWeek represents the sum of all hours logged by employees during the current week (Monday to Sunday). The pendingTimesheetsCount indicates how many timesheets are awaiting approval. The projectsOverBudget array lists projects that have consumed 80% or more of their budgeted hours. The topEmployees array shows the five employees who logged the most hours this week.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation DTO with no direct database table mapping. All properties are derived from real-time queries across multiple tables with organization context enforcement:

1. activeEmployeesCount: COUNT(*) FROM hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = ? AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL

2. totalHoursThisWeek: Calculate week boundaries (Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59) in organization timezone. SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 FROM hrm_platform_timelogs JOIN hrm_platform_employees ON timelogs.hrm_platform_employee_id = employees.id WHERE employees.organization_id = ? AND timelogs.date BETWEEN week_start AND week_end AND timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL

3. pendingTimesheetsCount: COUNT(*) FROM hrm_platform_timesheets JOIN hrm_platform_employees ON timesheets.hrm_platform_employee_id = employees.id WHERE employees.organization_id = ? AND timesheets.status = 'submitted' AND timesheets.deleted_at IS NULL

4. projectsOverBudget: For each project with budget_hours > 0, calculate actual_hours from timelogs this week. Filter WHERE (actual_hours / budget_hours) >= 0.8. Return array of nested objects with id, name, budgetHours, actualHours, utilizationPercentage.

5. topEmployees: GROUP BY employee_id, SUM(duration_minutes) for current week, ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5. Join with hrm_platform_employees and hrm_platform_user_profiles for displayName. Return array of nested objects with employeeId, displayName, totalMinutes.

All queries enforce organization_id filter. Return 0 for counts and 0 for hours when no data exists. Return empty arrays for projectsOverBudget and topEmployees when no matching records.

The total hours budgeted for this project.

This value comes from the project's budget_hours field and represents the planned or estimated hours for completing the project. Only projects with budget_hours > 0 are included in the budget utilization report.
budgetHours.x-autobe-specification: Mapped from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours. Number type with minimum 0. Source: projects table budget_hours column. Only projects with budget_hours > 0 are included.

actualHours.description:
The total hours logged by all employees during the current week.

This value is computed by summing the duration_minutes from all timelogs associated with this project for the current week (Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 in the organization's timezone), then converting to hours by dividing by 60.
actualHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed from SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for current week. Week boundary: Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 in organization's timezone. Only includes timelogs where project_id matches and deleted_at IS NULL.

utilizationPercentage.description:
The percentage of budget consumed, calculated as (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100.

This value indicates how much of the project's budget has been used. Projects appear in the over-budget list when this value is 80% or higher. A value of 100% means the project has consumed its entire budget.
utilizationPercentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed as (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100. Number type with minimum 0, maximum 100. Only projects where utilizationPercentage >= 80 are included in the response.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.IProje.description:
Project budget utilization summary showing budgeted hours versus actual hours logged for the current week.

This object represents a single project that has consumed 80% or more of its budgeted hours. The id uniquely identifies the project. The name is the project's display name. The budgetHours field shows the total hours budgeted for the project. The actualHours field shows the total hours logged by all employees during the current week (Monday to Sunday). The utilizationPercentage field indicates what percentage of the budget has been consumed, calculated as (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100.

Projects appear in this list only when their utilization percentage reaches or exceeds 80%.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.IProje.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation DTO joining hrm_platform_projects with hrm_platform_timelogs. For each project with budget_hours > 0: id from projects.id, name from projects.name, budgetHours from projects.budget_hours, actualHours from SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for current week (Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 in organization timezone), utilizationPercentage calculated as (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100. Only includes projects where utilizationPercentage >= 80. All queries enforce organization_id filter from session context and exclude soft-deleted records (deleted_at IS NULL).

id.description:
Unique identifier for the member account.

Auto-generated UUID assigned when the account is created. Used to reference this member in API operations and database relationships.

email.description:
Unique email address used for authentication and communication.

Serves as the primary identifier for login and password recovery. Must be unique across all member accounts. Users can update their email through account settings.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the member account was created.

Automatically set on account registration. Used for audit trails, sorting, and determining account age. Immutable after creation.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

Automatically updated when any account attribute is modified. Used for change tracking and identifying recently modified accounts.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the member account was soft deleted, null if active.

When set, marks the account as deleted while preserving historical data. Null value indicates the account is currently active.

profile.description:
Global user profile containing display name, avatar image, and phone number.

Each member has at most one profile that is shared across all organizations. The profile provides identity information (display name, avatar) that persists regardless of which organization context the user is working in. Null if the user has not created a profile yet.

IHrmPlatformMember.description:
Registered member account representing a global user identity in the multi-tenancy platform.

Contains the user's authentication email address and account metadata. Each member account can belong to multiple organizations through separate employee records, but this schema represents the global identity shared across all organization contexts. The profile relation provides the user's display name, avatar, and contact information.

This DTO is used in employee detail responses to show the associated user account. Sensitive fields like password_hash are excluded. The profile is included as a nested object since each member has at most one profile (1:1 relationship).
IHrmPlatformMember.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members table. Columns: id (UUID), email (string, unique), created_at (timestamptz), updated_at (timestamptz), deleted_at (nullable timestamptz). Relation: profile via JOIN to hrm_platform_user_profiles on hrm_platform_member_id (1:1, nullable). Excluded: password_hash (security), sessions/passwordResets/emailVerifications (internal auth), organizationMemberships/employees (HAS-MANY via separate endpoints).
